title: rectangle folding table
text: rectangle folding table. I bought this folding table for my tiny house and it is perfect for our use.  It's about 5' long... about 2' wide (eyeballing it)... I love that it has two pull down points instead of having to pull and snap all four legs... just two... one pull and snap for each side.  It's plenty sturdy enough to use for crafts, a small buffet or even extra dining.  It folds up flat to about 3".  The tan color is a darker, but still neutral color.  I've already used it numerous times and am very happy with my purchase.  I always update my reviews, answer questions/comments if new info would be useful.
